title: OL-PR-2085: land or supersede pull request #2085 (conflict)
body:

**Trigger:** lane pass: pull request #2085 is conflict
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 2085

SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1: the server owns pull request #2085 (`claude/project-thread-0bsdsz` at a9103361a8, opened by rwnq8): Restart the growth loop and code agents after the 11-22 stall. The session that opened it is not its closer and is never asked to act. The branch conflicts with main. Merge main into the branch and resolve it, or redo the change from main in a new pull request and close this one as superseded. **Prediction:** open_prs <= 0 within 24 h

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 2085` exits 0 (pull request #2085 is merged or closed).

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T14:31:47Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-25T15:33:30Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
